positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team member on open source relational database Azure PaaS offerings (Postgres & MySql). 
Occasional contributor to Sql Operations Studio, Sql Server on premise, and Azure Sql DB offerings.

positions.title: Director of Data Management
positions.description:
HackDFW is the largest hackathon in the south. Our 2015 event hosted over 700 hackers from around the world to build innovative technology products in 24 hours. These projects were judged by world class judges ( Mark Cuban, the President of Verizon Wireless, CEO of American Airlines, Mayor of Dallas, and Michael Irvin).

HackDFW was held at the Women's Museum in fair park. The event raised over $300,000 of in-kind and monetary donations through corporate sponsorships and partnerships. In addition HackDFW was publicized by NPR, The Dallas Morning News, and NASDAQ.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Key contributor to a team developing emerging customer insights through the interpretation and use of advanced analytical methodologies of viewership data (Uverse, DirectTV, OTT). Worked with technologies such as Hadoop, MapReduce, Apache Pig, Spark, Solr and many more to ingest and perform sophisticated analysis on extremely large datasets.
